prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: Silent Storm original gray painted glove/cloth UV diffuse, ID2153.
Image1 is the ONLY original edit target/reference: whole128x128 RGBA map enlarged nearest8x1024x1024. Refine this exact same flat painted UV texture for4x source resolution. Full square canvas, same source boundaries, muted gray/charcoal/brown palette and relative lightness. Preserve material identity, sourcewashed shape ambiguity and all dark silhouettes; no clothing photo or person.
The original cuffband is native[35,5,128,19]. It has exactly FORTY-SIX faint thin brighter vertical paint strokes at native x36,38,40,...126, TWO-native-pixel pitch. These alternate23 slightly stronger source strokes at x38,42,...126 and23 weaker strokes at x36,40,...124. Keep the exact source count, pitch, phase, contrast and original narrow washed width. These are existing faint painted shading lines, NOT new knitted ribs, pleats, wovencloth crossings, embroidery, raised relief or a new materialpattern. Do not add horizontal or diagonal threads/lines. Keep its original dark margins and original subdued shading.
Preserve one large plain gray backfield native[35,19,128,128] with its existing soft broad gray washed transitions and weak darker foldshading. This source field has no resolved grain pattern or seams: do not introduce pores, photo leather/cloth weave, coarsegrain, curls, hatching, raised borders, crisp diagonal creaseedges or new marks.
Keep the four original small/long left material washfields in their unchanged irregular source silhouettes/envelopes: lefttop[7,3,29,21], leftmiddle[2,24,30,111], leftbottom[0,112,12,128] and[12,111,30,128]. Retain every original dim brown/gray highlight, darkline and weak angular contour within those existing washes. Unknown tiny hollow/round/hinge-looking shapes remain indistinct soft source paint: do not interpret them as eyes, mechanical hinges, rings, knuckles, fingernails, stitches, buttons or other anatomy/hardware. No new parts, completion or rearrangement. Improve only original soft transitions and very fine matte paint within already-varied source areas, at original physical detail scale.
Original alpha255 everywhere. Flatblack/dark source UV fields are opaque painted dark areas, not transparent holes; keep their exact boundaries/interiors. Wholecanvas only: no crop, padding, boundingbox recentering, registration, letterbox, newmargin/border, labels, text, faces, watermark, objects or scene. Output the same original muted hand-painted texture.
reference_recipe: Exact original128x128 wholeRGBA nearest8x1024x1024; no crop/padding/BBox/artistic edit; inverse wholeLanczos512x512, numeric gain and complete original A only.
